responsibility: Supplies the declarative extension-definition entry set for Ventana-specific ISA extensions within the RISC-V extension registry. In this revision it mainly defines XVentanaCondOps metadata—name, description, version support, grouping, and feature-bit placeholders—so the generic extension-option and documentation generators can treat Ventana conditional-operations support as part of the same centralized extension catalog used for standard and other vendor extensions.
